messages:
support-ops: FYI — CustZ reports a big p99 latency spike for API in eu region since ~09:20 UTC. Customer traces show TLS + auth tail. p50 OK, p99 +1.1s. Trace: https://redwood.traces/0xabc123, req ids: req-17f2, req-17f3

alice: Oncall, taking this. Can you paste a minimal repro and the trace IDs?

support-ops: TraceID=0xabc123. Sample req: req-17f2. Repro (customer):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.eu.redwood.run/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response shows long TLS handshake then auth timeout.

ben: Looked at the trace — TLS handshake per-req ~800-1200ms on the tail, then auth svc adds ~200-400ms. DNS shows AAAA lookup falling back to A in some POPs. Putting packet captures into the trace link.

carmen: We pushed a GSLB weight change at 09:00 to move maintenance traffic off eu1 -> eu2. Noted a small change in health-check smoothing too. Rolling change id: gslb-2026-0317-0900. Could be correlated.

darius: Provider reports brief BGP neighbor flap at 09:18 in the eu transit. Might have caused transient reroutes/longer AS path for some POPs. Investigating with provider.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: GSLB change applied by carmen at 2026-03-17T09:00Z (gslb-2026-0317-0900).

alice: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) pin CustZ traffic to eu1 (pre-change) via per-tenant GSLB override, 2) enable temporary client retry/backoff in proxy for TLS handshake failures, 3) route auth calls to eu1 local replica for this tenant. Ben/Carmen, can we do 1 now?

ben: Pushing GSLB override: `/infra/gslb/overrides set tenant:CUSTZ -> eu1` (pushed). Also added a short-lived auth routing rule to prefer local replica for tenant CUSTZ.

support-ops: Customer confirmed after pin: p99 dropped from ~1.2s to ~240ms for their measured requests. They see big improvement. :white_check_mark:

carmen: Rolling back the 09:00 weight bump to avoid oscillation while we investigate. Rollback id: gslb-2026-0317-0925-rollback applied.

darius: Provider says BGP neighbor had a soft flapping due to scheduled infra update at their side — they fixed the neighbor. No persistent route leaks found.

alice: Follow-ups (action items):
- OP-445: add GSLB health-check smoothing + hysteresis (so small short flaps don't shift weights instantly)
- OP-446: per-tenant routing affinity metric in Console + alerting
- OP-447: consider bumping auth DNS TTL to 30s to reduce cross-pop churn during transient routing changes
- CS-7894: customer ticket, incident summary + mitigation steps (support-ops)

support-ops: Ticket CS-7894 created, customer notified of temporary pin and rollback action. Will keep them updated.

alice: Longer-term: instrument TLS handshake timing per-pop in the ingesters so we can alert when TLS tail deviates by region. Also add a synthetic probe that exercises auth->api roundtrip from multiple POPs.

ben: Agreed. Also adding a short-term tweak: increase auth service connect timeout for cross-pop calls from 500ms -> 1s to avoid spurious timeouts during transient routing. Will monitor.

support-ops: Closing for now; reopen if we see recurrence. Thanks all. :pray:
